items.stem: You want an automatically updating table of contents. What must the document use?

options.rationale: Correct: a generated table of contents is built from heading styles.

options.text: Bold, larger text for each heading
options.rationale: Visually bold text is not a heading style and is ignored by the TOC.

options.text: A manually typed list of page numbers
options.rationale: A manual list does not update when pages shift.

options.text: A spreadsheet pasted at the top
options.rationale: A pasted sheet is not a table of contents.

items.explanation: Correct: a generated table of contents is built from heading styles.

Offline is about connectivity, not review workflow.

items.stem: Which TWO actions improve the accessibility of an exported document? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Add descriptive alt text to images
options.rationale: Correct: alt text lets screen readers describe images.
Correct: ordered headings give assistive tech a navigable structure.
Colour alone fails users who cannot distinguish colours.

options.text: Replace headings with larger bold text
options.rationale: Bold text is not a semantic heading.

items.explanation: Correct: alt text and a real heading hierarchy both make an exported document accessible.
